company.name: OpenReplay
company.shortDescription: OpenReplay is an open-source, self-hostable, session replay and product analytics platform.
company.description:
OpenReplay is an open-source, self-hostable, and developer-friendly session replay stack.

Founded in 2018, the company is based in NYC, New York.

productsAndServices.description: A tool that records and replays user interactions within web applications to help understand user behavior and troubleshoot issues.
productsAndServices.name: Session Replay

productsAndServices.description: A platform that analyzes user journeys, conversion funnels, trends, and heatmaps to measure product performance and user engagement.
productsAndServices.name: Product Analytics

productsAndServices.description: A real-time collaborative feature that allows support agents to navigate and interact with users' sessions to assist and resolve issues.
productsAndServices.name: Co-Browsing

productsAndServices.description: A developer toolkit integrated with session replay that provides detailed technical insights such as network activity, console logs, and error tracking.
productsAndServices.name: DevTools

productsAndServices.description: APIs and integrations that connect OpenReplay with backend logs, monitoring tools, and internal systems to enrich session data and export it.
productsAndServices.name: Integrations & API

productsAndServices.description: An AI assistant that provides natural language insights on user behavior, technical issues, and product analytics using session data.
productsAndServices.name: kAI (AI Assistant)

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $4,700,000, or 76.42% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,111,558 to $28,295,101, a 9.09x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
